bullets.text: Built a privacy-first RAG pipeline that documents legacy PHP/JS codebases with no code leaving company infrastructure: LangChain ingestion, 2,000-character chunks, Linq-Embed-Mistral embeddings in a local Chroma store, and Llama 3 via Ollama; retrieval surrounds each chunk with related cross-file context, achieving a 90% reduction in manual documentation work.
Developed an automated call-quality assessment tool using WhisperX transcription (STT) and rule-based LLM analysis, replacing manual QA audits.
Ran internal workshops on LLM capabilities and prompt engineering, accelerating adoption of AI tooling across the development team.
